name: Corning Costar 3335 6 well
author: Ramona Optics
notes: Corning Costar 6 well cell culture multiple well plate, cat# 3335, CellBIND surface, clear virgin polystyrene (meets USP Class VI), flat-bottom round wells, sterile, with lid. SURFACE: 3335 is the CellBIND-treated item; the identical mould is also sold as 3506 (standard TC-treated), 3516 and 3471 - Corning's cell culture dimension sheet lists 3335, 3506, 3516 and 3471 on a single row with one set of dimensions, so this definition covers all four. Surface chemistry does not change any geometry in this file. CONTROLLING DOCUMENT: Corning customer drawing DWG00673 Rev D, 'COSTAR 6 WELL PLATE WITH COVER', drawn CBL 10/03/96, rev D dated 6/22/18, prod code 144. The drawing's own revision block ties it to catalogue 3506 ('REVISED PER CO# 05780 WAS 144-3506'), not to 3335; it is used for 3335 because the dimension sheet puts 3335 and 3506 on the same mould row and because the per-catalogue Product Description for 3335 (rev 9, 2 Feb 2026, certs-ecatalog.corning.com/life-sciences/product-descriptions/3335.pdf) reproduces the drawing exactly - plate 5.030 x 3.365 in (127.76 x 85.47 mm), well top diameter 1.395 in (35.43 mm), well bottom diameter 1.370 in (34.80 mm), well depth 0.685 in (17.40 mm). The drawing is vector with no text layer and was read as a 100 dpi render, with the section view re-cropped at 300 dpi. Every dimension in this file is a millimetre value in parentheses on that drawing: plate length 127.76 mm, plate width 85.47 mm, plate height without cover 20.27 mm (the .798 in dimension on the section view; the base-plus-cover stack view gives 22.63 mm WITH the cover on, matching the Product Description's 'Height with lid 0.891 in' - the lid is not modelled here, so the lid-off 20.27 mm is used). Well center-to-center 39.12 mm, marked 'Typ.' and dimensioned on both the horizontal and the vertical run. Well top inside diameter 35.43 mm, recorded in 'diameter' per the top-diameter convention; well bottom inside diameter 34.80 mm. Well depth 17.40 mm. Grid is 2 rows (A-B) x 3 columns (1-3) with A1 top-left, as drawn and as numbered 1-6 on the top view. A1 well center offsets are dimensioned directly on the drawing's top view: 24.76 mm from the left edge and 23.16 mm from the top edge - nothing derived, and they agree with Corning's convention that 'A1 Column Offset' is measured from the left and 'A1 Row Offset' from the top. Bottom thickness 1.27 mm and well bottom elevation above the plate underside 2.54 mm (the working-distance numbers; neither is a field in this schema). Well volume 16.8 mL, working volume 5 mL per the Product Description, growth/bottom area 9.5 cm^2, flange/skirt height 13.74 mm. VENDOR ARITHMETIC: the drawing's own vertical dimensions do not close - well depth 17.40 + bottom thickness 1.27 + well bottom elevation 2.54 = 21.21 mm against the stated plate height of 20.27 mm. The identical 0.94 mm gap appears on the 12 well sheet DWG00674 (17.53 + 1.27 + 2.16 = 20.96 vs 20.02), so it is a datum convention on Corning's sheets rather than a misread; each value is recorded here as printed. Drawing tolerances are 'nominal for reference only'; the Product Description states +/- 0.050 in on its dimensions. CROSS-CHECK: Corning's family sheet 'Microplate Dimensions for Corning Cell Culture Microplates' dated 1/16/2019 (footer 'Corning Restricted'; no longer served from corning.com and read from the Internet Archive snapshot web.archive.org/web/20240119081431if_/https://www.corning.com/catalog/cls/documents/drawings/MD_Microplate_Dimension_Sheets_Multiple_Well.pdf) agrees with the drawing on every value in this file, including both A1 offsets. Note that www.corning.com returns 403 to a bare curl and to a browser user-agent alone; a full browser header set including Referer and Sec-Fetch-* is needed to download DWG00673. Units in meters. Use 'pitch' and origin reference to compute all well centers.
